question: After the API-client repair and conflict refresh, should this PR ship with a legacy Installed Apps opt-in reset and the Play Data Safety upload lane in the next Android release?
rationale: Automation can identify the code defect, but disabling existing opt-ins and adding a Google Play release-credential lane are compatibility and release-policy choices.

options.title: Ship reset with rollout
options.body: Approve the legacy opt-in reset, require the Data Safety upload to use the dependency client, verify Play materials, refresh the branch, and land the PR.

options.title: Revise consent or reset
options.body: Request different disclosure wording, consent-version behavior, or upgrade handling if existing opt-ins should not be reset this way.

options.title: Hold release automation
options.body: Land only the Android consent gate or keep the PR open until Data Safety CSV, Play Console state, and privacy-policy materials are ready together.

recommendation.title: Ship reset with rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the legacy opt-in reset, require the Data Safety upload to use the dependency client, verify Play materials, refresh the branch, and land the PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android settings, preference migration, and Android tooling history makes this the best available owner for the rollout and conflict-refresh decision.
